_doc: Runtime values read by the SDK scripts, web app and keeper. programId null = the address in the SDK IDL. deployed false = the program is not on that cluster yet: the site says so, /demo shows its not-available state and /api/health reports program not_deployed. Mint null = created on demand (localnet) or set after the devnet deploy.

demo._doc: Demo shops (PRD 4.6). sharedShop serves /api/demo/session and the keeper heartbeats it; shop windows are fixed at creation and lifecycle uses the same owner key, so lifecycle.shopWindows must equal sharedShop.windows. sellerFloat is kUSD kept in the shared seller's own account to fund each dying shop (fresh owner per /api/demo/dying-shop, key discarded after issue). showcaseShop has realistic windows for screenshots and the merchant board; seed-demo tops its owner up to sol from the admin key.

scriptRpc._doc: Scripts (lifecycle, seed-demo, init-config) on a public endpoint: requests start minGapMs apart; a 429 waits retryMs, doubled per retry.

demo._doc: Demo shops (PRD 4.6). sharedShop serves /api/demo/session and the keeper heartbeats it; shop windows are fixed at creation and lifecycle uses the same owner key, so lifecycle.shopWindows must equal sharedShop.windows. sellerFloat is kUSD kept in the shared seller's own account to fund each dying shop (fresh owner per /api/demo/dying-shop, key discarded after issue). showcaseShop has realistic windows for screenshots and the merchant board; seed-demo tops its owner up to sol from the admin key.

demoTerms._doc: Terms text of every demo warranty. Hashed (canonical JSON, with kind, reserve and termSecs added) into terms_hash and stored off chain so /w/[pda] can show the text and prove it matches.

promise.en: The shop installed this unit and will fix any fault in its installation work free of charge while this card is valid. It answers each claim within its response window; if it stays silent, the reserve is paid to the card holder. The manufacturer's own warranty is separate and unchanged.
promise.ms: Kedai memasang unit ini dan akan membaiki sebarang kerosakan pada kerja pemasangannya tanpa caj selagi kad ini sah. Kedai menjawab setiap tuntutan dalam tempoh jawapannya; jika kedai diam, rizab dibayar kepada pemegang kad. Waranti pengeluar adalah berasingan dan tidak berubah.

keeper._doc: apps/keeper: every intervalSecs it heartbeats the shops of heartbeatRoles (at most once per heartbeatEverySecs), declares lapsed shops dormant first, then sends each due permissionless instruction (15 to 20) with feePayerRole paying, at most maxActionsPerPass per pass. A failed send is logged and retried next pass. It writes lastRunKey to the data store for /api/health.

web._doc: Web app values. /api/rpc forwards only allowedMethods (never sendTransaction: signed transactions go through the relayer); programScopedMethods must name the Kekal program. DATA_BACKEND picks the store; KEKAL_SQLITE_PATH and KEKAL_MIGRATIONS_DIR override the paths below.

relay._doc: POST /api/relay pays the fee for a transaction the holder already signed. At least one key other than the relayer must sign. Only these Kekal instructions, TransferChecked of a non-zero amount of an allowed mint out of the signer's own associated account, and creation of the associated account that transfer pays into (at most maxAccountCreates per transaction) pass. accountCreatesPerDay caps all rent the relayer pays per day: those creations plus every Kekal instruction that names the relayer as rent payer (claim records and payout accounts, which the program never closes). The relayer key may appear only as fee payer and in the account slots named in payerAccounts. maxSigners caps the signatures (relayer included) the relayer pays the fee for. Limits are fixed windows.

session._doc: Seller and arbiter sign-in: nonce, signed message, httpOnly cookie. KEKAL_SESSION_SECRET (32+ chars) signs the cookie; without it the session endpoints answer 503.

demo._doc: POST /api/demo/*: the server signs as the shared demo seller and the demo arbiter so a visitor needs no wallet. Seller and arbiter actions only touch warranties a demo session issued. Fixed-window limits per caller IP and per day overall.

clientIp._doc: The peer is X-Real-IP (set by the reverse proxy), else the last X-Forwarded-For entry. The CDN header is trusted only when that peer is inside cdnRanges (Cloudflare published ranges). An IPv6 client is limited per ipv6PrefixBits prefix, not per address. The reverse proxy must overwrite X-Real-IP; a caller who can reach the app port directly picks its own bucket.

site._doc: Public address and link previews. KEKAL_SITE_URL overrides url. robots.txt lets every crawler read pages but not /api/; previewBots get their own group so chat and social link previews keep working if the default group is ever narrowed. The OG card is apps/web/src/app/opengraph-image.png, drawn by brand/render-og.mjs; its alt text is meta.ogAlt in the locale files. The favicon is apps/web/src/app/icon.svg (the brand/logo.svg mark redrawn on a 32 px grid, K as a path so no font is needed); apple-icon.png is drawn from it by brand/render-icons.mjs at appleIcon.size, full bleed on an opaque square because iOS rounds the corners itself. themeColor is the browser bar colour and must equal the --paper token in globals.css (a test checks).

warrantyPage._doc: /w/[pda] and /semak. The card key travels in the URL fragment (#<keyFragment>=<base58 seed>) and never reaches the server; after activation the new key stays in this browser under storagePrefix + warranty address; it is written there as pending (suffix .pending, at most pendingKeysMax keys) before the activation is sent and promoted once the chain shows it as holder. After a failed or unconfirmed activation send the holder is read activationRecheck.tries times, waitMs apart, before the page says the result is not known yet. The timeline lists the latest timelineLimit transactions of the warranty; decoded events are cached per signature in memory (eventCacheSize). issueTypes are the claim categories offered to the buyer (labels: claim.issue.<type> in locales).

estimate._doc: Approximate ringgit shown beside kUSD amounts, always labelled as an estimate. A fixed rate, not a live price.

demoPage._doc: /demo: the browser makes a throwaway card key, asks /api/demo/session (the shop goes silent) or /api/demo/dying-shop (the shop closes) for a warranty to it, keeps the warranty address under storageKey and the key under warrantyPage.storagePrefix (so /w/[pda] knows it), and reads /api/warranty/[pda] every pollMs while a deadline runs. claimIssue is the issue type the claim form starts on.

examples._doc: /contoh renders config/examples.json: the report written by `pnpm lifecycle --cluster <name> --out ../config/examples.json` (paths A to E, every transaction). It is shown only when its cluster is the one the site runs on; otherwise the page says the examples are not recorded yet. paths sets the order.

submit._doc: POST /api/submit broadcasts a transaction a seller or arbiter wallet already signed and pays for itself (the server adds no signature). Only these Kekal instructions, idempotent associated-account creation and compute-budget instructions pass; the relayer key may not appear at all. Fixed window per caller IP.

terms._doc: POST /api/terms keeps the terms text of a warranty a seller issued from /kedai. Accepted only when its SHA-256 equals the warranty's on-chain terms_hash, so no sign-in is needed; the first write wins.

shopBoard._doc: /kedai and /timbang. windows = the claim windows a new shop starts with (fixed at creation, checked on chain against the cluster limits). termMonths are the warranty lengths offered (secsPerMonth each); reserve is the starting reserve per card in whole units. The boards re-read the chain every pollMs. card = the A6 PDF page in points and the PNG card in pixels.

home._doc: Home page. repoUrl / videoUrl null = link not shown (set when the repository is public and the video exists). whySourceUrl is the source linked under the insurance sentence in the Why section. The live numbers are reused for statsCacheSecs between visitors; a read slower than statsTimeoutMs leaves them out of that page view.

data._doc: Off-chain store. backend sqlite (file at sqlitePath) or supabase (Postgres; the connection string is read from the variable postgres.urlEnv names, never from this file). Both run supabase/migrations; *.pg.sql files are Postgres-only. prepare false suits the Supabase transaction pooler. DATA_BACKEND, KEKAL_SQLITE_PATH and KEKAL_MIGRATIONS_DIR override.
